info.title: FieldLoop internal mock hydrology sources
info.description: Simulated read-only simulator endpoint from architecture section 4.2. Not a web-api/BFF endpoint. Run behind Cloud Run invoker IAM in dev/demo; local reads need no credentials. No live public API, no real rain radar, gauge or tide connector and no write operation. A reading reaches the platform only as a signal.v1 message published in process.

servers.description: Local simulator as the repository README starts it. Deployed environments call the private simulator-{env} Cloud Run service with a Google OIDC ID token.

get.description: Return the simulated reading of one kind at asOf: rain rate at sensor S-R1, canal level at S-L1 or tide level at S-T1. The value is a pure function of kind and asOf, plus any Scenario override; the clock is the caller's asOf or the committed run's, never wall time.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Served kinds: rain, level and tide. Any other kind is 404.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Timezone-aware Scenario time, not wall time; the response reports it in UTC as observedAt. When omitted it is the clock of the Scenario player's committed run, or the start of the Bangkok storm simulation (2026-10-12T00:00:00Z) when there is no run.

400.description: Invalid asOf, or an undeclared or repeated query parameter; code validation_failed, input values are not echoed.

405.description: Only GET is served, so every other method is refused; code method_not_allowed, and Allow names the methods the path serves. No state mutation.

serviceIdentity.description: Verified by Cloud Run invoker IAM, not proxy headers. The handler does not implement browser auth or independently validate IAM.
